Built on a hard asset

Utopia turns the full-floor penthouse atop Palms Place into the most exclusive wellness members club and private event venue in Las Vegas. It opens as-is, and investor funds buy it outright.

Three revenue streams: a small, high-value members club, premium private buyouts during Las Vegas's biggest weeks, and brand, wellness and media partnerships.

The founders

"Inspired by ancestral wisdom, harnessing earth's richest elements and ancient rituals to heal mind, body and spirit."
Tamar Kaprielle, Founder of Utopia

Tamar Kaprielle

"Kaprielle" · Co-Founder and Managing Partner

The visionary behind Utopia and founder of Kaprielle, a luxury healing skincare brand built on 24K gold and Moroccan rose rituals. She launched the world's first pure 24K gold mask, which went viral worldwide, and was named one of Maxim's "5 Rising Female Entrepreneurs to Watch Right Now." She leads Utopia's design, treatments and product line.

Maria Matarelli

"KYA" · Co-Founder and Managing Partner

Founder and CEO of Formula Ink, an international consulting company that has advised Fortune 100 companies, billion-dollar organizations and startups reaching multi-million dollar valuations. Bestselling author of Workaholic: A 12-Step Guide to Having a Life, Getting Things Done and Personal Agility: Unlocking Purpose, Alignment and Transformation, international speaker, and international DJ and producer, KYA, who has played the Super Bowl pregame, the NHL playoffs, the F1 Grand Prix and Burning Man. She brings more than 10 years of hosting and producing events, from VIP villa gatherings and retreats in Bali to exclusive VIP events in Las Vegas as founder of the KYA KLUB.
